lp.title: Landing pages
lp.sub: Pages for one product with an order box inside, made for ads. Orders carry the page they came from.
lp.off: Landing pages are switched off: customers see none of them until you switch them on in the card below. You can still build and publish.
lp.emptySub: One product, one offer, an order box on the page — made for ads.

card.d: While it is off the shop shows no landing page to customers. Search engines never list them.
card.on: Show published landing pages to customers
card.readOnly: You can see this but not change it.

b.headline: Headline
b.partsSub: Switch parts on or off; their order is fixed for the best results.
b.wordsSub: Your own words. Prices always come from the product itself.
b.benefits: Why this product — one reason per line
b.benefitsBn: The same reasons in Bengali, one per line
b.timerHelp: The countdown hides itself after this time.
b.previewSub: A sketch of the parts that are on, in their order.
b.publishConfirm: Publish now — customers can open it
b.readOnly: You can see this page but not change it.

err.STALE: Someone changed this page meanwhile. It was read again — check and save once more.
err.SLUG_TAKEN: That link is already used by another page.
err.PRODUCT_OFF: The product is not on sale, so the page cannot be published.
err.WRONG_STATE: That step does not fit the page's state now.
err.ARCHIVED: An archived page is restored before it is changed.
err.forbidden: You do not have permission for this.
